title: Special permit to modify use or bulk regulations

blocks.html: For any zoning lot within the Queens Plaza Subdistrict of the Special Long Island City Mixed Use District, the City Planning Commission may permit modification of the use or bulk regulations, except floor area ratio requirements, provided the Commission shall find that:
blocks.plainText: For any zoning lot within the Queens Plaza Subdistrict of the Special Long Island City Mixed Use District, the City Planning Commission may permit modification of the use or bulk regulations, except floor area ratio requirements, provided the Commission shall find that:

blocks.html: (a)        such use or bulk modification will aid in achieving the general purposes and intent of the Special District;
blocks.plainText: (a) such use or bulk modification will aid in achieving the general purposes and intent of the Special District;

blocks.html: (b)        such use modification will encourage a lively pedestrian environment along the street or mandatory sidewalk widening, or is necessary for the programmatic requirements of the development;
blocks.plainText: (b) such use modification will encourage a lively pedestrian environment along the street or mandatory sidewalk widening, or is necessary for the programmatic requirements of the development;

blocks.html: (c)        such bulk modifications will enhance the distribution of bulk on the zoning lot;
blocks.plainText: (c) such bulk modifications will enhance the distribution of bulk on the zoning lot;

blocks.html: (d)        such bulk modifications will permit adequate access of light and air to surrounding streets and properties; and
blocks.plainText: (d) such bulk modifications will permit adequate access of light and air to surrounding streets and properties; and

blocks.html: (e)        such use or bulk modification will relate harmoniously to the character of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: (e) such use or bulk modification will relate harmoniously to the character of the surrounding area.

blocks.html: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
blocks.plainText: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the surrounding area.
